_comment_purpose: Quality gate catalog. A gate is a named check or reviewer goal that an agent identity must satisfy. Reviewer-swarm goals reference this catalog via id; reviewer identities compose the same gates via `qualityGates`. Three gate kinds are supported: `checks` (CI-style command), `review-goal` (specialized reviewer focus), and `command` (manual command).

gates.description: Run the project's TypeScript type check (tsc --noEmit or equivalent) before marking work complete.
Run `git diff --check` on the working tree to catch whitespace/conflict-marker errors.
Changed-code architecture boundary review: flag regressions in module ownership, coupling, and runtime integration shape introduced by implementation changes.
Changed-code correctness review: flag unsafe boundaries, broken imports, and behavior mismatches in implementation diffs.
Validation and evidence review for implementation changes: require concrete test/check output before marking complete.
Security and concurrency review for implementation changes: flag secrets leakage, unsafe filesystem/process handling, and race/concurrency risk in modified code.
